column3: ## Successfully upload a file containing an article with references
Setup: Ensure that the publisher account owns a journal with Print ISSN "1111-1111" and E-ISSN "2222-2222", and these are not attached to any other journals
Setup: You must be logged in using a pure publisher account (no other privileges)
Go to the "Upload Article XML" tab in the "Publisher Area"

Select "Choose file" and select the test resource file "with_references.xml"

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/3985_references_article_metadata/doajtest/xml_upload_test_package/DOAJ/with_references.xml

column4: A flash message appears at the top of the screen indicating a successful upload
Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with status "pending"

column3: wait a short amount of time for the job to process, then reload the page (do not re-submit the form data).  If the job remains in "pending", reload the page until the status changes.

column4: Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with status "successfully processed", and the Note "1 articles imported (1 new, 0 updated)"

column3:
Go to the Table of Contents for the journal (e.g. by going to /toc/2222-2222), go to the Articles tab and open the article "References!"

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//toc/2222-2222

column4: A "References" section is shown on the article page, below the keywords
The references are shown as a numbered list, in the same order as they appear in the uploaded file, and all 4 references are present
The DOI "10.1234/abc" in the first reference is a link to https://doi.org/10.1234/abc, and it opens the DOI resolver in a new tab
The URL "https://www.doaj.org/" in the second reference is a link, and it opens in a new tab
The third reference contains no links
The fourth reference displays its markup as text, i.e. the text reads: Taylor, C. (2023) A reference with markup in it. - no part of it is rendered as italics
